title: Opulent Thai Tofu Curry
description: A savory, dense, romantic Thai tofu curry infused with a silky coconut creme patissiere and a nimono-simmered broth, perfect for a macrobiotic-friendly feast.
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess moisture and cut into 1-inch cubes.
In a small saucepan, whisk together 200ml coconut milk, 2 tbsp arrowroot powder, and 2 tbsp sugar, then heat until thickened to form a coconut creme patissiere, stirring constantly.
In a separate pot, heat 1 tsp sesame oil over medium heat and add 2 tbsp green curry paste, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add sliced lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves to the pot and sauté for another minute.
Pour in 200ml coconut milk for the curry, stir in 2 tbsp arrowroot powder to thicken, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Gently fold in the tofu cubes and 1 tbsp soy sauce, letting the curry simmer for 5 minutes so the tofu absorbs the flavors.
Stir the prepared coconut creme patissiere into the simmering curry, creating a rich, creamy base.
Add fresh basil leaves and squeeze in 2 tbsp lime juice, stirring until the basil wilts.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional soy sauce or sugar if needed, then remove the pot from heat.
Serve the curry hot over steamed brown rice or quinoa, garnished with extra basil and a drizzle of sesame oil.
